A single place to view the documentary records of the College, arranged exactly as they appear in the evaluation instruments. Browse by area, or search across every record by name.

Please read before continuing

Tarlac State University is a state university created by law of the Republic of the Philippines. Its programs operate under the supervision and regulation of the Commission on Higher Education. The College of Education maintains the records presented here.

This portal is provided for review and verification. Records open in Google Drive and may ask you to sign in with a Google account. Documents remain the property of Tarlac State University and are not to be copied, altered, or redistributed without written permission from the University.

For official information about the University, visit www.tsu.edu.ph.
